accounts.authDescription: An account on this server is required to use Chapchoo.
accounts.codeSent: Enter the code from your email. Requesting a new code replaces the previous one.
accounts.useCode: Log in with an email code
accounts.loginUnavailable: Login is unavailable. Contact your server administrator.
accounts.linkRequired: Open the link provided by your server administrator to continue.
accounts.invalidProof: This link has expired, was already used, or is unavailable. Ask for a new link.
accounts.signupSent: If signup is available for this address, a link has been sent. Check your email.
accounts.resetDone: Your password was changed. Log in with your new password.
accounts.personalDescription: Your personal space is always available. It cannot be shared, left, or deleted.
accounts.contextDescription: Choose your space or a team. Creating an account does not accept team invitations automatically.
accounts.invitationDescription: Team invitations sent to your account email appear here.
accounts.handleDescription: A unique name for this team on the server.
accounts.teamDescription: Your role determines which members and team settings you can manage.
accounts.inviteDescription: You can invite someone who has not signed up yet. They still need to create an account; a team invitation does not grant access to sign up on this server.
accounts.ownerLeaveDescription: Transfer ownership before leaving. Only the owner can delete this team.
accounts.confirmDescription: This changes access to the team. Continue?
accounts.transferWarning: You will become a manager and the selected member will become the owner. Continue?
accounts.deleteWarning: The team and all Agents in it, including their saved Computer data, will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
accounts.leaveAgentWarning: Your Agents in this team and their saved Computer data will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
accounts.removeAgentWarning: This member’s Agents in the team and their saved Computer data will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
accounts.genericError: The request could not be completed. Check the current state before trying again.
accounts.invalidSession: Your session has ended. Log in again.
accounts.permissionDenied: Your role does not allow this action. Refresh to check your current access.
accounts.conflict: This item has changed or the name is already in use. Refresh and check your changes.
accounts.invalidCode: The code is invalid or expired. Request a new code.
accounts.weakPassword: Use 8–64 printable ASCII characters, with at least three of: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, symbols.
accounts.emailMismatch: Enter the email address that received this link or invitation.
accounts.registered: This email already has an account. Log in instead.
accounts.registrationRequired: Create your account before accepting this invitation.
accounts.mailUnavailable: Email delivery is not configured on this server.
accounts.capacityExhausted: Password processing is busy. Try again shortly.
accounts.readError: Could not load the current information. Reload to try again.
accounts.invalidInput: Check the entered values and try again.
